description: {"time": 1783112245536, "blocks": [{"id": "gpx356v11l", "data": {"text": "The Maybach matatu from Oromats Sacco is a celebration of luxury and aspiration on Nairobi's streets. Named after the ultra-premium Mercedes-Benz marque, this matatu's livery featured lavish gold accents, sleek pinstriping, and a commanding front-end portrait that demanded respect on the road. Dennis Muraguri's woodcut rendering emphasises the bold graphic lines and regal bearing that made this vehicle a standout in the Oromats fleet. Muraguri's practice is rooted in observation \u2014 he sketches matatus in their natural habitat, capturing details that enthusiasts recognise instantly. The woodcut medium lends itself perfectly to the graphic, high-contrast aesthetic of matatu airbrushing, translating three-dimensional design into a composed two-dimensional artwork. This reproduction c-type print is ideal for anyone drawn to automotive culture, African urban art, or the intersection of street style and fine art printmaking.
